title: Auckland rail, wastewater and regional services gain named accounts
summary: City Rail Link, Central Interceptor and the Auckland Council area connect operational milestones to local service needs while preserving the scope of boarding counts, flow estimates and community priorities. Eligible identities reach 70 projects and 36 places, not completed-portfolio totals.
evidence_note: Sixteen primary-source records inspected November 22. Passenger start, practical completion, operator-declared full wastewater operation and separate connecting projects keep distinct dates. Network boardings, estimated avoided overflow, storage capacity, design rates and facility visits retain their units and geographic scopes.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
